# committed by

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:committedBy`](gmeow-committedBy.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/committedBy>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/software`](../../slices/software.md)

The agent who committed the changes to the repository — the person or process that created the commit object. Distinct from the author (who wrote the patch).
